content.summary: PETAH TIKVA, Israel (AP) — Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd. (GILT) on Wednesday reported net income of $9.8 million in its second quarter. On a per-share basis, the Petah Tikva, Israel-based company said it had net income of 17 cents. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring costs, were 21 cents per share.
